fusions.name: Buried to the Hilt
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 30 damage, is always a critical hit, uses up every affliction on the target, adding the damage they had left, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fanned Blades
fusions.desc: Throws 2 heavy blades at once in a spread; each deals 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hold the Edge Back
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Comes Out
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your physical damage rises 40% for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
